sentences.japanese: もしも、音楽が愛の糧であるならば、奏で続けよ。
sentences.english: If music be the food of love, play on.

sentences.japanese: そこにいる間、生活の糧はどうするのだ。
sentences.english: What will you live on while you are there?

sentences.japanese: 今日満足したことは明日の糧になる。
sentences.english: That which was satisfied today becomes tomorrow's provisions.

sentences.japanese: 渇した者に水を、飢えたる者には糧を与えよ。
sentences.english: Give water to the thirsty and food to the hungry.

sentences.japanese: 我らに今日も日々の糧をお与えください。我らの負い目をお許しください。我々も、我らに負い目のある者たちを許します。
sentences.english: Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
